strings.A finding is tied to the evidence that p: A finding is tied to the evidence that produced it. Historical events stay historical. Missing data does not become a healthy verdict. strings.The KillerBench.Engine is a Windows diag: The KillerBench.Engine is a Windows diagnostics and repair library for applications that need structured evidence instead of a collection of opaque scripts. It powers the KillerBench desktop and command-line tools, and it can be embedded in another .NET host.
strings.The desktop shell presents Engine output: The desktop shell presents Engine output through Raw output and Readable report views. Its confirmations and Open, Save, and Folder dialogs follow the active app theme. Those controls belong to the desktop host; an embedded host must provide its own review and authorization UI while preserving the Engine's evidence, prerequisite, journaling, and verification gates.
strings.The full system scan is diagnostic-only,: The full system scan is diagnostic-only, including when a focused workflow has automatic repair enabled.
